newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EPP selects candidates for parliament election.
newsitem.headline: EPP selects candidates for parliament election.

text.p: The European People's Party on Thursday selected its candidates for the vice presidencies of the European Parliament.
The parliament's second biggest group will put forward at Tuesday's election four deputies who were vice presidents in the first half of the Parliament's five-year term.
They are France's Nicole Fontaine, who was the first vice-president, Georgios Anastassopoulos from Greece, Antonio Capucho from Portugal and Ursula Schleicher of Germany.
The EPP also selected Otto Bardong and and Vincenzo Violo as its candidates for the posts of quaestors, parliamentary watchdogs who oversee MEPs' interests and spending.
Under a precooked arrangement with the biggest group, the Socialists, it is certain that the EPP's Jose Gil-Robles Gil-Delgado will be elected as president on Tuesday.
